reason: The finding is mostly valid, but its proposed text has one defect. (1) The gap is real. R27-A4 (7)(a) exists only in the text to be logged at 23:30Z, and CONTEXT has 0 hits for 'W4 FREEZE: NIGHT 29 Sep' at 19:51Z. PC28-01 shows that session crons have never fired (0 of 31), so the 23:33Z freeze cron 5ece5d24 will probably not run on its own. The only standalone rule is the 12:25Z line, 'if 51 is not terminal by the freeze -> exp89q'. It has no header cutoff and says nothing about the case where no freeze was logged. (2) The morning ambiguity is real. AMEND 3 scoped the 23:30Z dummy-PASS deadline to W4 = 00:05-01:45Z. AMEND 4 relabels W4 as '3 night + 2 morning' and 'keeps the 23:30Z dummy-PASS deadline'. MORNING TABLE v1.1 (4) gives no time, and exp89l is built only after 51 reads. (3) DEFECT: the proposed line quotes the literal 'W4 FREEZE: NIGHT 29 Sep'. R27N-3 G4 runs grep -cF on that exact string in CONTEXT.md and needs a count >= 1. Logging the fallback verbatim would make G4 pass when no freeze was logged, and the fallback's own condition ('no line containing X exists') could never be true. (4) The '<= 23:30:00Z' header cutoff conflicts with R27N-2 (2), which allows manual polls until 23:59Z and lets the first successful header decide. It also discards information for no pre-registration benefit. 51's admit limit is 22:59:57Z, so its display is fixed before 23:00Z, and GAP RULE v2 already codes any late L_hi (a late 0/- becomes '?' -> exp89q). The real anti-post-hoc boundary is the stack's own submit. This is plan hygiene with no LB effect and costs one CONTEXT line, so it stays feasible and consistent with R1-R10.
fix: Log NOW, pre-score (quote the newest PENDING header, e.g. 19:42:46Z), WITHOUT the freeze literal: 'NO-FREEZE FALLBACK (R27-A4 (7)(a), logged early): if the 23:30Z freeze line was not logged when a night step runs, STACK = exp89r only if a successful poll header stamped before the stack's submit shows 56640366 COMPLETE with display >= 0.959, or 0.958 with an attributable UP (SubmissionCount 53), coded under R25-A1 (4) + GAP RULE v2 (a late + / 0u = UNPROVEN-ins; a late 0 / - = ?); otherwise, or with no successful header, STACK = exp89q. A read after the stack is submitted never changes it. 56640366 is terminal by its 22:59:57Z admit limit, so any later header reads the same display. The 23:30Z dummy-PASS deadline (AMEND 3/4) covers the night files only. A morning file needs its dummy PASSED before its decision header (A-M1 latest 08:40Z, B-M1 10:30Z, M2 11:00Z), else it is UNUSED (v1.1 (4)).' Then (a) write the freeze line with the exact header 'W4 FREEZE: NIGHT 29 Sep' and (b) make G4 anchor on it, e.g. grep -cE '^- 2026-09-2[89] [0-9:]+ UTC, W4 FREEZE: NIGHT 29 Sep', so no other line can satisfy it. If the main session prefers the 23:30Z cutoff for consistency with R27-A4 (7)(a), it must also align R27N-2 (2) ('until 23:59Z'), so the freeze and no-freeze paths use the same cutoff.
realistic_gain: 0 on LB. Insurance only: it stops a crons-never-fire night (PC28-01) from choosing exp89r/exp89q ad hoc, and stops a late exp89l PASS from being read as disqualifying A-M1. Cost is one CONTEXT line and one grep tweak, with no GPU and no API calls.
